def problem(x: np.ndarray) -> float:

    f(x) = (x.T @ A @ x) + (b.T @ x) + c + sum(sin(3*x)) + sum(x[i]*x[j] for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i+1, len(x)))

    b = np.array([0.5, -0.3, 0.2]) # Linear coefficients # Adjusting to improve skew or linearity

    sinusoidal_term = np.sum(np.sin(3 * x))
    interaction_term = sum(x[i] * x[j] for i in range(len(x)) for j in range(i + 1, len(x)))

    return quadratic_term + linear_term + c + sinusoidal_term + interaction_term
